filesystem.description: Provides filesystem access within allowed directories

github.description: GitHub MCP server for repository operations

gmail.description: Email — READ AND DRAFT ONLY. The send capability is denied below, not classified: FR-012 requires it absent from the tool surface, because a capability that cannot be reached is a stronger guarantee than one that is guarded. A saved draft is its own confirmation gate — nothing leaves until the user presses send.

googlecalendar.description: Calendar. Tier map lives in .omni-harness/policy/rules.yaml: reads and free/busy are Tier 1, a tentative hold is Tier 2, and delete/update/decline are Tier 3. Creating an event that emails other people is raised to Tier 3 by an argument exception — the assistant cannot un-reach an inbox.

session-watcher.description: Feature 001's read-only coding-session watcher (FR-018). This entry IS the integration point — the gateway has no external tool-registration API, so without it the watcher's tools never reach the agent and 'what are my sessions doing?' answers 'I don't have that tool'. Disabled by default: it needs the watcher process running on the host.
